<section id="lab-1-kv-cache-memory-calculator" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-1-kv-cache-memory-calculator">Lab 1: KV cache memory calculator</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb19-1"><a href="#cb19-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> dataclasses <span class="im">import</span> dataclass</span>
<span id="cb19-2"><a href="#cb19-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-3"><a href="#cb19-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="at">@dataclass</span></span>
<span id="cb19-4"><a href="#cb19-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">class</span> ModelKVConfig:</span>
<span id="cb19-5"><a href="#cb19-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    num_layers: <span class="bu">int</span></span>
<span id="cb19-6"><a href="#cb19-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    num_kv_heads: <span class="bu">int</span></span>
<span id="cb19-7"><a href="#cb19-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    head_dim: <span class="bu">int</span></span>
<span id="cb19-8"><a href="#cb19-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    bytes_per_element: <span class="bu">int</span></span>
<span id="cb19-9"><a href="#cb19-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-10"><a href="#cb19-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> kv_cache_bytes(config: ModelKVConfig, sequence_length: <span class="bu">int</span>, batch_size: <span class="bu">int</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">1</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="bu">int</span>:</span>
<span id="cb19-11"><a href="#cb19-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> (</span>
<span id="cb19-12"><a href="#cb19-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        batch_size</span>
<span id="cb19-13"><a href="#cb19-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> config.num_layers</span>
<span id="cb19-14"><a href="#cb19-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> sequence_length</span>
<span id="cb19-15"><a href="#cb19-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> <span class="dv">2</span></span>
<span id="cb19-16"><a href="#cb19-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> config.num_kv_heads</span>
<span id="cb19-17"><a href="#cb19-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> config.head_dim</span>
<span id="cb19-18"><a href="#cb19-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">*</span> config.bytes_per_element</span>
<span id="cb19-19"><a href="#cb19-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb19-20"><a href="#cb19-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-21"><a href="#cb19-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> gib(num_bytes: <span class="bu">int</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="bu">float</span>:</span>
<span id="cb19-22"><a href="#cb19-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> num_bytes <span class="op">/</span> (<span class="dv">1024</span> <span class="op">**</span> <span class="dv">3</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-23"><a href="#cb19-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb19-24"><a href="#cb19-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="va">__name__</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="st">"__main__"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb19-25"><a href="#cb19-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    config <span class="op">=</span> ModelKVConfig(</span>
<span id="cb19-26"><a href="#cb19-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        num_layers<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">32</span>, num_kv_heads<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">8</span>, head_dim<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">128</span>, bytes_per_element<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">2</span></span>
<span id="cb19-27"><a href="#cb19-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb19-28"><a href="#cb19-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> seq_len <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="dv">1024</span>, <span class="dv">2048</span>, <span class="dv">4096</span>, <span class="dv">8192</span>, <span class="dv">32768</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb19-29"><a href="#cb19-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        per_request <span class="op">=</span> kv_cache_bytes(config, seq_len)</span>
<span id="cb19-30"><a href="#cb19-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        batch_32 <span class="op">=</span> kv_cache_bytes(config, seq_len, batch_size<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">32</span>)</span>
<span id="cb19-31"><a href="#cb19-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(</span>
<span id="cb19-32"><a href="#cb19-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="ss">f"seq_len=</span><span class="sc">{</span>seq_len<span class="sc">:&gt;6}</span><span class="ss"> | "</span></span>
<span id="cb19-33"><a href="#cb19-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="ss">f"per_request=</span><span class="sc">{</span>gib(per_request)<span class="sc">:6.2f}</span><span class="ss"> GiB | "</span></span>
<span id="cb19-34"><a href="#cb19-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="ss">f"batch32=</span><span class="sc">{</span>gib(batch_32)<span class="sc">:7.2f}</span><span class="ss"> GiB"</span></span>
<span id="cb19-35"><a href="#cb19-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb20"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb20-1"><a href="#cb20-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">python</span> kv_cache_calculator.py</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Bài tập: đổi <code>num_kv_heads</code> 8→32 (MHA vs GQA); <code>bytes_per_element</code> 2→1 (FP8 KV); tính batch tối đa nếu còn 40 GiB cho KV.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-2-đo-ttft-itl-với-streaming-client" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-2-đo-ttft-itl-với-streaming-client">Lab 2: Đo TTFT / ITL với streaming client</h3>
<p>Giả sử OpenAI-compatible endpoint tại <code>http://localhost:8000/v1</code>:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb21-1"><a href="#cb21-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> time</span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a href="#cb21-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> openai <span class="im">import</span> OpenAI</span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a href="#cb21-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a href="#cb21-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>client <span class="op">=</span> OpenAI(base_url<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"http://localhost:8000/v1"</span>, api_key<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"EMPTY"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-5"><a href="#cb21-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>model <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"your-model-name"</span></span>
<span id="cb21-6"><a href="#cb21-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>messages <span class="op">=</span> [</span>
<span id="cb21-7"><a href="#cb21-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    {<span class="st">"role"</span>: <span class="st">"system"</span>, <span class="st">"content"</span>: <span class="st">"You are a concise technical tutor."</span>},</span>
<span id="cb21-8"><a href="#cb21-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    {<span class="st">"role"</span>: <span class="st">"user"</span>, <span class="st">"content"</span>: <span class="st">"Explain KV cache in LLM inference in 5 bullet points."</span>},</span>
<span id="cb21-9"><a href="#cb21-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span>
<span id="cb21-10"><a href="#cb21-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-11"><a href="#cb21-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>start <span class="op">=</span> time.perf_counter()</span>
<span id="cb21-12"><a href="#cb21-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>first_token_time <span class="op">=</span> <span class="va">None</span></span>
<span id="cb21-13"><a href="#cb21-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>last_token_time <span class="op">=</span> <span class="va">None</span></span>
<span id="cb21-14"><a href="#cb21-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>num_chunks <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">0</span></span>
<span id="cb21-15"><a href="#cb21-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>collected_text <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb21-16"><a href="#cb21-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-17"><a href="#cb21-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>stream <span class="op">=</span> client.chat.completions.create(</span>
<span id="cb21-18"><a href="#cb21-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    model<span class="op">=</span>model,</span>
<span id="cb21-19"><a href="#cb21-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    messages<span class="op">=</span>messages,</span>
<span id="cb21-20"><a href="#cb21-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    max_tokens<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">256</span>,</span>
<span id="cb21-21"><a href="#cb21-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    temperature<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">0.2</span>,</span>
<span id="cb21-22"><a href="#cb21-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    stream<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb21-23"><a href="#cb21-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb21-24"><a href="#cb21-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-25"><a href="#cb21-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> event <span class="kw">in</span> stream:</span>
<span id="cb21-26"><a href="#cb21-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    now <span class="op">=</span> time.perf_counter()</span>
<span id="cb21-27"><a href="#cb21-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    token_text <span class="op">=</span> (event.choices[<span class="dv">0</span>].delta.content <span class="kw">or</span> <span class="st">""</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-28"><a href="#cb21-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> token_text:</span>
<span id="cb21-29"><a href="#cb21-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">if</span> first_token_time <span class="kw">is</span> <span class="va">None</span>:</span>
<span id="cb21-30"><a href="#cb21-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            first_token_time <span class="op">=</span> now</span>
<span id="cb21-31"><a href="#cb21-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        last_token_time <span class="op">=</span> now</span>
<span id="cb21-32"><a href="#cb21-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        num_chunks <span class="op">+=</span> <span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb21-33"><a href="#cb21-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        collected_text.append(token_text)</span>
<span id="cb21-34"><a href="#cb21-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(token_text, end<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">""</span>, flush<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-35"><a href="#cb21-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-36"><a href="#cb21-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>end <span class="op">=</span> time.perf_counter()</span>
<span id="cb21-37"><a href="#cb21-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"</span><span class="ch">\n</span><span class="st">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-38"><a href="#cb21-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> first_token_time <span class="kw">is</span> <span class="va">None</span>:</span>
<span id="cb21-39"><a href="#cb21-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"No token received."</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-40"><a href="#cb21-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">else</span>:</span>
<span id="cb21-41"><a href="#cb21-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    ttft <span class="op">=</span> first_token_time <span class="op">-</span> start</span>
<span id="cb21-42"><a href="#cb21-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    e2e <span class="op">=</span> end <span class="op">-</span> start</span>
<span id="cb21-43"><a href="#cb21-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    generation_time <span class="op">=</span> (last_token_time <span class="kw">or</span> end) <span class="op">-</span> first_token_time</span>
<span id="cb21-44"><a href="#cb21-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    avg_itl <span class="op">=</span> generation_time <span class="op">/</span> <span class="bu">max</span>(num_chunks <span class="op">-</span> <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-45"><a href="#cb21-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"TTFT: </span><span class="sc">{</span>ttft<span class="sc">:.3f}</span><span class="ss"> s"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-46"><a href="#cb21-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"E2E latency: </span><span class="sc">{</span>e2e<span class="sc">:.3f}</span><span class="ss"> s"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-47"><a href="#cb21-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"Chunks received: </span><span class="sc">{</span>num_chunks<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-48"><a href="#cb21-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"Approx avg ITL per chunk: </span><span class="sc">{</span>avg_itl<span class="sc">:.3f}</span><span class="ss"> s"</span>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Lưu ý: đo theo chunk text, không phải token tuyệt đối; network/client ảnh hưởng kết quả.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-25-contents" aria-controls="callout-25" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Labs 3–9 (GPU) + cost calculator + mini-project
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-25" class="callout-25-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<section id="lab-3-vllm-openai-compatible-server" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-3-vllm-openai-compatible-server">Lab 3 — vLLM OpenAI-compatible server</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb22"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb22-1"><a href="#cb22-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">vllm</span> serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb22-2"><a href="#cb22-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--dtype</span> auto <span class="at">--host</span> 0.0.0.0 <span class="at">--port</span> 8000</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb23"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb23-1"><a href="#cb23-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">curl</span> http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb23-2"><a href="#cb23-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">-H</span> <span class="st">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb23-3"><a href="#cb23-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">-d</span> <span class="st">'{</span></span>
<span id="cb23-4"><a href="#cb23-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">    "model": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct",</span></span>
<span id="cb23-5"><a href="#cb23-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Explain continuous batching in LLM serving."}],</span></span>
<span id="cb23-6"><a href="#cb23-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">    "max_tokens": 256, "temperature": 0.2</span></span>
<span id="cb23-7"><a href="#cb23-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">  }'</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Thêm <code>"stream": true</code> cho streaming. So sánh prompt ngắn/dài (TTFT), tăng <code>max_tokens</code> (E2E), gửi song song (throughput/ITL).</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-4-quan-sát-metrics" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-4-quan-sát-metrics">Lab 4 — quan sát <code>/metrics</code></h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb24"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb24-1"><a href="#cb24-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">curl</span> http://localhost:8000/metrics <span class="kw">|</span> <span class="fu">head</span> <span class="at">-n</span> 50</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Theo dõi <code>prompt_tokens</code>, <code>generation_tokens</code>, prefix cache, preemption, TTFT/TPOT histograms.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-5-vllm-bench-serve" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-5-vllm-bench-serve">Lab 5 — <code>vllm bench serve</code></h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb25"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb25-1"><a href="#cb25-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">pip</span> install <span class="st">"vllm[bench]"</span></span>
<span id="cb25-2"><a href="#cb25-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">vllm</span> bench serve <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb25-3"><a href="#cb25-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--backend</span> openai <span class="at">--base-url</span> http://localhost:8000 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb25-4"><a href="#cb25-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--model</span> Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb25-5"><a href="#cb25-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--dataset-name</span> random <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb25-6"><a href="#cb25-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--random-input-len</span> 512 <span class="at">--random-output-len</span> 128 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb25-7"><a href="#cb25-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--num-prompts</span> 512 <span class="at">--request-rate</span> 8</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Lặp <code>request_rate</code> ∈ {1,2,4,8,16,32}; input ∈ {128,512,2048}; output ∈ {64,256,1024}. Tìm saturation và chỗ TTFT/ITL gãy.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-6-prefix-caching" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-6-prefix-caching">Lab 6 — prefix caching</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb26"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb26-1"><a href="#cb26-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">vllm</span> serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct <span class="at">--dtype</span> auto <span class="at">--enable-prefix-caching</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Workload cùng system prompt dài × nhiều user question; <code>curl …/metrics | grep prefix_cache</code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-7-speculative-decoding" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-7-speculative-decoding">Lab 7 — speculative decoding</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb27"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb27-1"><a href="#cb27-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">vllm</span> serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct <span class="at">--dtype</span> auto <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb27-2"><a href="#cb27-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--speculative-config</span> <span class="st">'{"method":"ngram","num_speculative_tokens":4}'</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>So baseline off vs on: TTFT, ITL, TPS, memory, p95/p99 — không chỉ mean.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-8-tensorrt-llm-skeleton" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-8-tensorrt-llm-skeleton">Lab 8 — TensorRT-LLM skeleton</h3>
<p>Workflow tư duy: chọn model/precision → TP/PP/EP → quant → KV/scheduler → build/load → <code>trtllm-serve</code> → <code>trtllm-bench</code> / GenAI-Perf. Ghi lại version, GPU, CUDA, revision, precision, TP/PP/EP, max batch/seq/tokens, KV dtype, scheduler, length distribution. CLI đổi theo version — kiểm tra docs đúng bản đang dùng.</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-9-cost-calculator" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-9-cost-calculator">Lab 9 — cost calculator</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb28"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb28-1"><a href="#cb28-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> math</span>
<span id="cb28-2"><a href="#cb28-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-3"><a href="#cb28-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> cost_per_million_output_tokens(</span>
<span id="cb28-4"><a href="#cb28-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    gpu_count: <span class="bu">int</span>, gpu_hour_price: <span class="bu">float</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-5"><a href="#cb28-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    measured_output_tps: <span class="bu">float</span>, safety_factor: <span class="bu">float</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="fl">0.7</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-6"><a href="#cb28-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="bu">float</span>:</span>
<span id="cb28-7"><a href="#cb28-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    effective_tps <span class="op">=</span> measured_output_tps <span class="op">*</span> safety_factor</span>
<span id="cb28-8"><a href="#cb28-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> effective_tps <span class="op">&lt;=</span> <span class="dv">0</span>:</span>
<span id="cb28-9"><a href="#cb28-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"effective_tps must be positive"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-10"><a href="#cb28-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> gpu_count <span class="op">*</span> gpu_hour_price <span class="op">/</span> (effective_tps <span class="op">*</span> <span class="dv">3600</span>) <span class="op">*</span> <span class="dv">1_000_000</span></span>
<span id="cb28-11"><a href="#cb28-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-12"><a href="#cb28-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> required_gpus(</span>
<span id="cb28-13"><a href="#cb28-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    target_output_tps: <span class="bu">float</span>, measured_tps_per_gpu_at_slo: <span class="bu">float</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-14"><a href="#cb28-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    safety_factor: <span class="bu">float</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="fl">0.7</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-15"><a href="#cb28-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="bu">int</span>:</span>
<span id="cb28-16"><a href="#cb28-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    safe_tps <span class="op">=</span> measured_tps_per_gpu_at_slo <span class="op">*</span> safety_factor</span>
<span id="cb28-17"><a href="#cb28-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> safe_tps <span class="op">&lt;=</span> <span class="dv">0</span>:</span>
<span id="cb28-18"><a href="#cb28-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"safe_tps must be positive"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-19"><a href="#cb28-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> math.ceil(target_output_tps <span class="op">/</span> safe_tps)</span>
<span id="cb28-20"><a href="#cb28-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-21"><a href="#cb28-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="va">__name__</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="st">"__main__"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb28-22"><a href="#cb28-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Cost per 1M:"</span>, cost_per_million_output_tokens(<span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="fl">3.0</span>, <span class="dv">8000</span>, <span class="fl">0.7</span>))</span>
<span id="cb28-23"><a href="#cb28-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Required GPUs:"</span>, required_gpus(<span class="dv">50000</span>, <span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="fl">0.7</span>))</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</section>
<section id="mini-project-llm-serving-benchmark-report" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="mini-project-llm-serving-benchmark-report">Mini-project — LLM serving benchmark report</h3>
<p>Chạy OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM hoặc TensorRT-LLM). Ba workload: short-chat (≈256/128), rag-medium (≈2048/512), long-generation (≈1024/2048). Nhiều request rate/concurrency. Báo cáo TTFT/ITL/E2E p50/p95/p99, system TPS, RPS, error, GPU mem/util, prefix hit nếu có, cost/1M output tokens; saturation point; config production; SLO + autoscaling signal.</p>
<p>Template gợi ý:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb29"><pre class="sourceCode markdown code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode markdown"><span id="cb29-1"><a href="#cb29-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu"># LLM Serving Benchmark Report</span></span>
<span id="cb29-2"><a href="#cb29-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">## Model and Runtime</span></span>
<span id="cb29-3"><a href="#cb29-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span>Model / Runtime / version / GPU / Precision / KV dtype / Parallelism / max_model_len / max_num_seqs</span>
<span id="cb29-4"><a href="#cb29-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">## Workload table + Results table (TTFT/ITL/E2E/TPS/RPS/error)</span></span>
<span id="cb29-5"><a href="#cb29-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">## Bottleneck Analysis (prefill / decode / KV / scheduler / network)</span></span>
<span id="cb29-6"><a href="#cb29-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">## Cost + Recommendation (runtime, config, SLO, autoscale metric, risks)</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="checkpoint-questions" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="checkpoint-questions">Checkpoint questions</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>Vì sao decode phase của LLM thường memory-bound?</li>
<li>KV cache lưu gì và công thức memory của nó là gì?</li>
<li>Prefill ảnh hưởng TTFT như thế nào?</li>
<li>Decode ảnh hưởng ITL như thế nào?</li>
<li>Continuous batching khác static batching ở điểm nào?</li>
<li>PagedAttention dùng ý tưởng nào từ operating systems?</li>
<li>Prefix caching giảm latency trong tình huống nào?</li>
<li>Vì sao RPS không đủ để benchmark LLM serving?</li>
<li>Speculative decoding cần điều kiện gì để có lợi?</li>
<li>Khi nào nên thử TensorRT-LLM thay vì chỉ dùng vLLM?</li>
<li>Tại sao context length tối đa là quyết định capacity/cost?</li>
<li>Cost per 1M output tokens được tính từ benchmark như thế nào?</li>
<li>MQA/GQA giảm KV cache bằng cách nào?</li>
<li>Chunked prefill giải quyết xung đột prefill–decode ra sao?</li>
<li>Goodput khác raw system TPS thế nào?</li>
<li><code>max_num_batched_tokens</code> ảnh hưởng TTFT vs ITL thế nào?</li>
<li>Ba ràng buộc chính khi capacity planning LLM là gì?</li>
<li>Multi-LoRA hữu ích trong tình huống serving nào?</li>
<li>Streaming “không miễn phí” — overhead nào thường gặp?</li>
<li>Khi TTFT đột biến, bạn kiểm tra những tín hiệu nào trước?</li>
</ol>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-26-contents" aria-controls="callout-26" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Tự kiểm — đáp án ngắn
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-26" class="callout-26-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Mỗi step ít token mới nhưng đọc KV ngày càng dài → thường bị memory bandwidth, GPU dễ underutilized nếu batch nhỏ.</li>
<li>Key/value attention đã tính; <span class="math inline">\(\text{bytes}=L\cdot S\cdot 2\cdot H_{kv}\cdot d\cdot b\)</span>.</li>
<li>Prefill xử lý cả prompt → tạo KV + first logits; prompt/queue/prefill nặng → TTFT tăng.</li>
<li>ITL phản ánh khoảng cách giữa token decode; decode chậm/stall → ITL xấu.</li>
<li>Static giữ batch cố định tới khi mọi request xong; continuous đổi tập sequence mỗi iteration.</li>
<li>Virtual memory / paging: logical block → physical block không cần contiguous.</li>
<li>Nhiều request cùng prefix token-level (system prompt, template, RAG) và cache chưa evict.</li>
<li>Request khác nhau về input/output tokens; cùng RPS có thể khác xa công việc GPU.</li>
<li>Acceptance cao, draft rẻ, target lớn/decode memory-bound, QPS chưa saturate, output đủ dài.</li>
<li>Cần ceiling trên NVIDIA, team tune được, quant/multi-GPU path tối ưu, workload đủ lớn justify effort.</li>
<li>Tăng <code>max_model_len</code> tăng KV reserve/demand → ít concurrent sequences hơn, cost/capacity đổi.</li>
<li>Đo output TPS tại mức vẫn đạt SLO × safety factor; chia chi phí GPU-giờ cho effective TPS rồi scale về 1M tokens.</li>
<li>Giảm <code>num_kv_heads</code> so với số query heads → hệ số <span class="math inline">\(H_{kv}\)</span> trong công thức nhỏ hơn.</li>
<li>Chia prefill dài thành chunk, xen decode → giữ ITL mượt hơn khi có prompt dài.</li>
<li>Goodput chỉ đếm request/tokens thỏa SLO; raw TPS có thể cao nhưng nhiều request “hỏng UX”.</li>
<li>Budget nhỏ hơn thường giúp ITL; lớn hơn thường giúp TTFT/prefill throughput — cần bench workload thật.</li>
<li>Throughput constraint, KV memory constraint, latency SLO (TTFT/ITL) constraint.</li>
<li>Nhiều adapter/task/tenant trên cùng base model — tăng mật độ serve, vẫn phải quản lý memory/isolation.</li>
<li>Nhiều SSE/chunk, detokenize lặp, giữ HTTP lâu, backpressure, logging/tracing nhiều event.</li>
<li>Queue time, prompt length, prefix hit, trộn long/short traffic, GPU saturation, tokenizer CPU.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="glossary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="glossary">Glossary</h2>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 47%">
<col style="width: 52%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Thuật ngữ</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Định nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Acceptance rate</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tỷ lệ draft tokens được target model chấp nhận</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Chunked prefill</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chia prefill dài thành chunks để xen kẽ với decode</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Continuous batching</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Batching động theo từng decode iteration</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Decode</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phase sinh từng output token autoregressively</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Draft model</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Model/phương pháp nhẹ hơn dùng để đoán token trước</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>E2E latency</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thời gian từ gửi request tới token cuối</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Expert parallelism (EP)</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phân tán MoE experts qua nhiều GPU</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Goodput</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Throughput của request (hoặc tokens) thỏa SLO</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>In-flight batching</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tên khác của continuous / iteration-level batching</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>ITL</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Inter-token Latency — khoảng cách giữa các output token</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>KV cache</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cache key/value để tránh tính lại attention cho token cũ</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>KV cache quantization</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Lưu KV ở precision thấp hơn để giảm memory</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Multi-LoRA</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Serve nhiều LoRA adapter trên cùng base model</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>PagedAttention</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Attention với KV chia block/page, không cần contiguous</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Pipeline parallelism (PP)</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chia layers qua nhiều GPU</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Prefill</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phase xử lý prompt ban đầu và tạo KV cache</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Prefix caching</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Reuse KV cache cho shared prefix</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>RPS</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Requests Per Second</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Speculative decoding</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Draft nhiều token rồi target model verify</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>Tensor parallelism (TP)</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chia tensor operations qua nhiều GPU</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>TPOT</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Time Per Output Token</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>TPS</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Tokens Per Second (per-user hoặc system)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><strong>TTFT</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Time To First Token</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
<section id="summary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="summary">Summary</h2>
<ul>
<li>LLM serving = prefill + decode loop + streaming; metric đúng là TTFT / ITL / tokens/s / goodput, không chỉ RPS.</li>
<li>KV cache là tài nguyên nóng: ước lượng bằng <span class="math inline">\(L\cdot S\cdot 2\cdot H_{kv}\cdot d\cdot b\)</span>; MQA/GQA và quant KV tăng capacity.</li>
<li>Continuous / in-flight batching thay static batch khi output length lệch; chunked prefill giữ decode mượt khi prompt dài.</li>
<li>PagedAttention + prefix caching giảm waste/fragmentation và TTFT trên traffic lặp prefix.</li>
<li>Speculative decoding và TP/PP/EP là tối ưu có điều kiện — đo acceptance, communication và p99.</li>
<li>vLLM = velocity + HF/API; TensorRT-LLM = NVIDIA ceiling; quant LLM (FP8/INT4/AWQ…) đổi memory/throughput lấy risk quality.</li>
<li>Production: streaming có overhead; dashboard token-level; debug theo bảng triệu chứng; cost theo tokens dưới SLO; checklist trước launch.</li>
</ul>
<pre class="text"><code>Serve tokens under SLO — not just maximize GPU utilization.</code></pre>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-27-contents" aria-controls="callout-27" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">

</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Mental models mang sang Lesson 10
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-27" class="callout-27-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<pre class="text"><code>Weights static ≈ knowledge
KV cache ≈ per-request growing context memory
Batch ≈ set of active sequences each iteration
Goodput ≈ throughput that still meets TTFT/ITL SLO
Cost ≈ $/token at the operating point you can actually sell</code></pre>
</div>
